feature_queries.name: asof_race_info
feature_queries.sql:
WITH last_race_id AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date, ARG_MAX(r.raceId, r.date) AS last_raceId
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId=e.driverId AND r.date < e.date
  GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date
)
SELECT e.driverId, e.date,
       ra.year AS asof_year,
       ra.round AS asof_round,
       ra.circuitId AS asof_circuitId
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN last_race_id lri ON lri.driverId=e.driverId AND lri.date=e.date
LEFT JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = lri.last_raceId

feature_queries.name: season_to_date_driver
feature_queries.sql:
WITH as_of_year AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date,
         ARG_MAX(ra.year, res.date) AS asof_year
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results res
    ON res.driverId=e.driverId AND res.date < e.date
  LEFT JOIN races ra
    ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
  GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date
), base AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date, ra.year, res.points, res.positionOrder, res.grid
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results res
    ON res.driverId=e.driverId AND res.date < e.date
  LEFT JOIN races ra
    ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
)
SELECT b.driverId, b.date,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.year = ay.asof_year THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS season_races_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.year = ay.asof_year THEN b.points ELSE 0 END) AS season_points,
       AVG(CASE WHEN b.year = ay.asof_year THEN b.positionOrder END) AS season_avg_finish,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.year = ay.asof_year AND b.positionOrder<=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS season_podiums,
       AVG(CASE WHEN b.year = ay.asof_year THEN b.grid END) AS season_avg_grid
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN as_of_year ay ON ay.driverId=b.driverId AND ay.date=b.date
GROUP BY b.driverId, b.date

feature_queries.name: circuit_history_driver
feature_queries.sql:
WITH as_of_circuit AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date,
         ARG_MAX(ra.circuitId, res.date) AS asof_circuitId
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results res
    ON res.driverId=e.driverId AND res.date < e.date
  LEFT JOIN races ra
    ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
  GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date
), hist AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date, ra.circuitId, res.positionOrder, res.grid, res.points
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN as_of_circuit ac ON ac.driverId=e.driverId AND ac.date=e.date
  LEFT JOIN results res ON res.driverId=e.driverId AND res.date < e.date
  LEFT JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
  WHERE ra.circuitId = ac.asof_circuitId
)
SELECT driverId, date,
       COUNT(*) AS circuit_races_career,
       AVG(positionOrder) AS circuit_avg_finish,
       MIN(positionOrder) AS circuit_best_finish,
       AVG(grid) AS circuit_avg_grid,
       SUM(points) AS circuit_points_sum
FROM hist
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: driver_recent
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date, r.date AS race_date, r.grid, r.positionOrder, r.points, r.statusId
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId=e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
   AND r.date >= e.date - INTERVAL '730 days'
)
SELECT driverId, date,
       COUNT(*) AS res_cnt_730d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN race_date >= date - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS res_cnt_30d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN race_date >= date - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS res_cnt_90d,
       AVG(CASE WHEN race_date >= date - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN positionOrder END) AS avg_finish_90d,
       AVG(CASE WHEN race_date >= date - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN positionOrder END) AS avg_finish_365d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN race_date >= date - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN points ELSE 0 END) AS points_365d,
       AVG(CASE WHEN race_date >= date - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN grid END) AS avg_grid_365d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN race_date >= date - INTERVAL '365 days' AND positionOrder<=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS podiums_365d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN race_date >= date - INTERVAL '365 days' AND statusId<>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dnfs_365d
FROM base
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: driver_qual_recent
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date, q.date AS qual_date, q.position AS qpos
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN qualifying q
    ON q.driverId=e.driverId
   AND q.date < e.date
   AND q.date >= e.date - INTERVAL '730 days'
)
SELECT driverId, date,
       COUNT(*) AS qual_cnt_730d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN qual_date >= date-INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qual_cnt_90d,
       AVG(CASE WHEN qual_date >= date-INTERVAL '90 days' THEN qpos END) AS avg_qpos_90d,
       AVG(CASE WHEN qual_date >= date-INTERVAL '365 days' THEN qpos END) AS avg_qpos_365d,
       MIN(CASE WHEN qual_date >= date-INTERVAL '365 days' THEN qpos END) AS best_qpos_365d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN qual_date >= date-INTERVAL '365 days' AND qpos<=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top3_qual_365d
FROM base
GROUP BY driverId, date

feature_queries.name: driver_static
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.driverId, e.date, DATE_DIFF('day', d.dob, e.date)/365.25 AS driver_age_years FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN drivers d USING(driverId)

feature_queries.name: last_event_features
feature_queries.sql:
WITH last_race AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date,
         ARG_MAX(r.grid, r.date) AS last_grid,
         ARG_MAX(r.positionOrder, r.date) AS last_finish,
         ARG_MAX(r.points, r.date) AS last_points,
         ARG_MAX(r.statusId, r.date) AS last_statusId,
         MAX(r.date) AS last_race_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId=e.driverId
   AND r.date < e.date
  GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date
), last_qual AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date,
         ARG_MAX(q.position, q.date) AS last_qpos,
         MAX(q.date) AS last_qual_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN qualifying q
    ON q.driverId=e.driverId
   AND q.date < e.date
  GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date
)
SELECT e.driverId, e.date,
       lr.last_grid, lr.last_finish, lr.last_points,
       DATE_DIFF('day', lr.last_race_date, e.date) AS days_since_last_race,
       CASE WHEN lr.last_statusId IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN lr.last_statusId <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS last_race_dnf,
       lq.last_qpos,
       DATE_DIFF('day', lq.last_qual_date, e.date) AS days_since_last_qual
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN last_race lr ON lr.driverId=e.driverId AND lr.date=e.date
LEFT JOIN last_qual lq ON lq.driverId=e.driverId AND lq.date=e.date

feature_queries.name: current_constructor
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.driverId, e.date,
       ARG_MAX(r.constructorId, r.date) AS cur_constructorId
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN results r
  ON r.driverId=e.driverId AND r.date < e.date
GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date

feature_queries.name: constructor_season_strength
feature_queries.sql:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date,
         ARG_MAX(r.constructorId, r.date) AS cur_constructorId,
         ARG_MAX(ra.year, r.date) AS asof_year
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId=e.driverId AND r.date < e.date
  LEFT JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId=r.raceId
  GROUP BY e.driverId, e.date
), cons_entries AS (
  SELECT c.driverId, c.date, c.cur_constructorId, c.asof_year,
         rr.driverId AS entry_driverId, rr.points, rr.positionOrder
  FROM ctx c
  LEFT JOIN results rr
    ON rr.constructorId=c.cur_constructorId AND rr.date < c.date
  LEFT JOIN races ra2 ON ra2.raceId=rr.raceId
  WHERE ra2.year = c.asof_year
)
SELECT driverId, date,
       cur_constructorId,
       COUNT(*) AS cons_entries_season,
       SUM(points) AS cons_points_season,
       AVG(positionOrder) AS cons_avg_finish_season,
       SUM(CASE WHEN positionOrder<=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cons_podium_entries_season
FROM cons_entries
GROUP BY driverId, date, cur_constructorId

feature_queries.name: constructor_stability
feature_queries.sql:
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT e.driverId, e.date, r.constructorId, r.date AS race_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId=e.driverId AND r.date < e.date
   AND r.date >= e.date - INTERVAL '365 days'
), ranked AS (
  SELECT driverId, date, constructorId, race_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driverId, date ORDER BY race_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM hist
)
SELECT h.driverId, h.date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT h.constructorId) AS n_constructors_365d,
       MAX(CASE WHEN r1.constructorId IS NOT NULL AND r2.constructorId IS NOT NULL AND r1.constructorId<>r2.constructorId THEN 1
                WHEN r1.constructorId IS NOT NULL AND r2.constructorId IS NOT NULL THEN 0
                ELSE NULL END) AS changed_constructor_last_race
FROM hist h
LEFT JOIN ranked r1 ON r1.driverId=h.driverId AND r1.date=h.date AND r1.rn=1
LEFT JOIN ranked r2 ON r2.driverId=h.driverId AND r2.date=h.date AND r2.rn=2
GROUP BY h.driverId, h.date
